purpose: Rejected color/layout exploration; retain original approved instrument UI.

variants.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. High-fidelity edit of the attached real metronome iOS app screenshot, preserving its existing precise instrument aesthetic. Input image is the exact layout, typography, material and bevel reference, not loose inspiration. Produce one finished full-screen portrait app UI mockup, same proportions as reference, front-on, no phone frame, no presentation background or annotations. Preserve: warm ivory chassis, graphite lettering, large condensed-bold 96 BPM recessed display, 1 2 3 4 keys with amber LED lenses and metrical weight hierarchy, precise ivory rotary knob, + and - buttons, typography, soft shadows, margins, and TAP key. TWO changes only: (1) Restore a clearly tappable METER control on the HOME screen: replace the small plain '4/4 · CLASSIC' status line between dial and transport with one tactile ivory rounded rectangular key, left-aligned with the other keys, approximately 170pt wide and 51pt tall, label small 'METER', value '4/4' and a downward chevron. To its right keep only small quiet 'CLASSIC' text. This entire row must fit neatly between knob and transport, with no overlaps. METER must be visually unmistakable as a button. (2) Replace the rejected green Play button with the specified color treatment below. Preserve exactly its rounded rectangle dimensions, proportions, optical-center triangular icon, bevel and realistic satin plastic finish. No green anywhere. Do not add extra controls or decorative labels. Retain all controls inside the frame. No watermarks. Palette hex values are targets, not text to print. Ivory key matching adjacent TAP key (#EAE6DD top to #DDD9CE bottom), with burnt-orange play triangle (#C6532D). The restrained ivory face and one orange glyph create a cohesive Piano-family design.
